in_marathi.name: Ayodhya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayodhya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ayodhya is the name of a legendary city in Hindu mythology, known as the capital of the ancient Raghav Dynasty ruled by King Rama. The name Ayodhya is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ayus’ which means ‘life’ and ‘Dhya’ which means ‘that which is not perishable or indestructible’. Thus, Ayodhya is a symbol of immortality and indestructibility.
